description:
I’m Piyush, an Engineering Admission Counsellor helping students across Maharashtra make smart and realistic choices for their engineering journey.
I guide students through college and branch selection, along with CAP rounds, cutoff analysis, and option filling, in a clear and structured way.
My focus is on practical guidance and honest insights, so students understand their options without confusion.
My goal is to make the admission process simple, transparent, and stress-free for every student.
